definitions.availability: end-of-day retrospective reference; no historical publication timestamp guaranteed
definitions.breadth: positive-volume issues with finite reported returns; missing returns are not flat
definitions.cap_weighted_change_pct: current-day capitalization weighted observed active returns; not an investable index
definitions.equal_weight_change_pct: arithmetic mean of observed active-issue returns
definitions.market_cap_total: all upstream issues, including no-trade/suspended rows
definitions.weighted_return_20d: compounded descriptive daily reference; not a tradable portfolio return
